# ABOUT US

A committed clinical research partner in Algeria

Founded in 2023, ES-CR specializes in clinical research in Algeria, combining local expertise with international standards.

Driven by a multidisciplinary team combining expertise in clinical research, pharmacoeconomic studies, medical affairs, academic teaching and research, we place quality, scientific rigor and operational excellence at the heart of everything we do.
